title: Full PNG Hero Carousel with Transparent Cutouts Placed
description: Per user directive ('hero section carousel should be full png. place the cutout for now.'), re-architected components/hero/hero-carousel.tsx from a split two-column layout into a unified, Apple-grade Full-Stage Full-PNG Hero Canvas (min-h-[75vh] sm:min-h-[82vh] lg:min-h-[88vh]). Generated 3 photorealistic, high-resolution transparent PNG cutouts (hero-cutout-bespoke-framing.png, hero-cutout-spatial-signage.png, and hero-cutout-industrial-cnc.png) into public/images/hero/ using Playwright headless rendering with alpha transparency at 1440×1632, 1880×1280, and 1720×1440 resolutions. Placed the cutouts inside the hero dropzone using Next.js <Image fill priority /> with smooth scale transitions, prominent designer specifications, and retained all carousel controls and test IDs. All 67/67 Playwright tests pass (100% pass rate) with 0 TypeScript/build errors.

Center Stage showcases transparent cutout PNGs with Next.js <Image fill priority /> and subtle hover scale effect
Designer drop zone styling retained with data-testid="hero-png-dropzone", dashed border, 'Hero Asset Drop Zone' label, file path badge, and 'Format: Transparent PNG • High-Res 300 DPI' specification

Editorial typography and actions integrated: data-testid="hero-headline", data-testid="hero-subheadline", category eyebrow badge with Sparkles/Compass/Cpu, CTAs cta-customise-frame and cta-explore-collections, and trust micro-badge
Touch swiping, prev/next arrows (hero-carousel-prev, hero-carousel-next), slide indicators (hero-carousel-indicators, hero-carousel-indicator-*), and AnimatePresence slide transitions retained
npm run build completes with 0 errors (13/13 static pages generated)
Full Playwright test suite passes with 100% pass rate (67/67 passed)
High-resolution proof screenshots captured for desktop dark, desktop light, and mobile viewports saved to .agent/screenshots/ and copied to parent brain directory
